{{Quote|Unless the owner is named Eat, the apostrophe is superfluous. I'm inclined to beat up the owner for bad grammar. Why, Trey, is that better?|Voort saBinring|<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Eat's''' was a two story domed commercial building located in [[Ackbar City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. It had a large marquee sign in its front that featured its name.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
